content:
Here’s this week’s shipping recap 👇

— Nano Banana 2 & Nano Banana Pro are now GA and available via the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Gemini API, and in @GoogleAIStudio

—Co-Scientist, our new multi-agent system for structured scientific thinking, generates and refines novel hypotheses to solve complex scientific problems

— dreambeans from @GoogleLabs works overnight to curate a personalized daily collection of topics that are relevant to you based on your connected Google apps

— @GoogleGemma 4 12B, our unified encoder-free model, brings powerful multimodal intelligence straight to your laptop fully offline

— Gemma 4 models and their drafters are now optimized with Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) to cut memory requirements and maximize on-device performance

— @GoogleMagenta RealTime 2 is our open-weights live music model that you can play like an instrument using a MIDI keyboard, text prompts, and gestures
author: GoogleAI
reason: 本文に「now GA」とあり、一般提供が開始されているため。
title_ja: Nano Banana 2 & Nano Banana Pro GA提供開始
summary_ja: Nano Banana 2とNano Banana Proが一般提供（GA）され、Gemini Enterprise Agent Platformなどで利用可能に。

content:
You can now create and edit images directly in Gemini Live.

Whether testing out room decor, getting help with math, or creating shareable memes, it all happens in real-time.

Just open the Gemini app, tap the Live button, share your camera, and tell Gemini what you want to see.

title:
ICYMI: Last month in AI news, we: 

🎬 Released Gemini Omni, our new model that lets you combine and input images, audio, video and text and generate high-quality videos grounded in Gemini's real-world
content:
ICYMI: Last month in AI news, we: 

🎬 Released Gemini Omni, our new model that lets you combine and input images, audio, video and text and generate high-quality videos grounded in Gemini's real-world knowledge.

🤝 Unveiled new AI Search features like information agents, custom coding capabilities and a new, intelligent Search box

⚡ Launched Gemini 3.5, our latest family of models combining frontier intelligence with action, starting with 3.5 Flash

😎 Updated @GeminiApp to become a more helpful AI assistant, featuring an intuitive new UI, personalized daily briefs and Gemini Spark

💻 Introduced Googlebook, a newly designed laptop experience built from the ground up for Gemini Intelligence, made by our hardware partners @Acer, @ASUS, @Dell, @HP and @Lenovo

💪 Released the @GoogleHealth app, a go-to hub for health and wellness, combining the best of Fitbit tracking with new and advanced capabilities

⌚ Announced our new lightweight, screenless Google Fitbit Air — the smallest tracker in our lineup

🗾 Introduced an experimental new way to simulate and explore realistic, interactive 3D environments of real-world places right from your browser by combining Project Genie with Street View

👓 Revealed our upcoming intelligent eyewear, with new frames and features that let you get directions, send texts, snap photos and more — all without taking out your phone

✅ Expanded SynthID and other verification tools in Search, Gemini, @GoogleChrome, Pixel and @GoogleCloud so you can easily understand how content was edited and created
author: Google
reason: 本文に「Released Gemini Omni」「Launched Gemini 3.5」「Updated Gemini App」とあり、すでにリリース済みであるため。
title_ja: Gemini Omniのリリース、新AI検索、Gemini 3.5 Flash
summary_ja: Gemini Omni（画像・音声・動画・テキスト入力対応）、新AI検索機能、Gemini 3.5 Flash、GeminiアプリUI更新などがリリースされました。
